confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Lima cost-of-living snapshots (Expat Arrivals, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, BootsNall). These are mixed in date and only partly dated. Soles were converted at about 3.4 PEN per USD, the rate implied by those sources. No direct restaurant wine-by-the-glass price was found, so the wine glass anchor is set at about 2.2 times the beer anchor, following the beer-relationship basis for wine. The cocktail anchor is a bounded estimate from a downtown-club price point and a pisco sour price range. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings or booking pages. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries that cite the RBA RSS feed and overview page; I did not open those pages directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Lima-specific aggregated estimates. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge model estimates for Lima's hostel and hotel market.
